Thank you for helping translate Element X!

Our strings are managed with [Localazy](https://localazy.com/p/element) and imported into this repository automatically every week, so pull requests that edit string resources directly can't be merged. Please submit your translations on Localazy instead. More details in [our contributing guide](https://github.com/element-hq/element-x-android/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#i-want-to-help-translating-element).
